points.heading: Practice -er
points.body:
Today deepen the **-er** family with **comer**. Stem **com-** plus **-o / -es / -e** gives **como**, **comes**, **come**. Try **beber** and **leer** (leo, lees, lee) the same way.

Make food sentences: yo **como** arroz, tú **comes** fruta, él **come** pan. Then swap only the person ending and keep the stem.

Practice: Now it's your turn. Your turn. Write yo / tú / él for comer, beber, and leer. Box every -es ending.

Common mistake: Using -ar endings on -er verbs (tú comas). Present tú for -er is comes.

lesson.summary: In this lesson, you will use Spanish verb endings to say who does an action.
lesson.memoryPhrase: Spanish families: **-ar** (cantar → canto, cantas, canta), **-er** (comer → como, comes, come), **-ir** (vivir → vivo, vives, vive).
lesson.weekRecap: Spanish families: -ar (cantar), -er (comer), -ir (vivir). Conjugate for yo, tú, and él in the present.
lesson.priorDayRecap: Yesterday you practiced -ar forms with cantar and hablar.
